simple.meaning: טָב (ṭâb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “good.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 5:17. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טָב (H2869).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
